question: Does the selective entry12 rank-two program reach the final RMS-normalized tied unembedding mainly through the recurrent residual identity path rather than layer-12--17 attention/MLP writes?

prior_art.known_lessons: The oracle route's complete suffix writes mediate only .14-.21; the selective rank-two program's attention12/13 factor banks mediate below .012. Complete-state boundary swaps are tautologically exact and do not isolate the direct path.
prior_art.novelty: Freeze every complete attention and MLP write in layers 12-17 to its native-off value while the selective rank-two entry state remains on, and verify the resulting final-state delta against the literal product of recurrent residual coefficients.

frozen_design.program: Reconstruct each opposite-parity rank-two union and gold-route A1/A2/off exactly as in the factor atlas.
frozen_design.factorial: Capture all twelve complete suffix writes under 00 native-off and 11 routed-on. Run 01 off entry plus on writes and 10 on entry plus off writes, with semantic-prefix absolute replacement. Replay both full captured write banks once.
frozen_design.direct_state_law: For cell 10, every suffix write is identical to cell 00 and x0/v1 are unchanged. Therefore the final residual delta must equal gamma times the entry12 delta, where gamma is the product of block.lambdas[0] over layers 12-17. Verify rowwise at the final semantic token before evaluating logits.
frozen_design.final_head: Recompute each cell's logits exactly as 30*tanh(lm_head(rms_norm(final_state))/30), report answer-minus-foil response, and require replay. This establishes the literal decoder edge but remains task-specific until OOD routing exists.
frozen_design.controls: Require authority, cross-fit geometry, target sufficiency, write replay, factorial closure, direct-state relative error, exact-head replay, P/C KL/flips, finiteness, and exact price.

predictions.pred_a_authority_replay_geometry_closure: All hashes, rank-two geometry, row coverage, write replay, factorial closure, exact final-head replay, finite metrics, and literal price pass.
predictions.pred_b_suffix_write_bank_is_minor: Joint suffix-write reset loss and rescue have signed projection <0.25 in every A1/A2 held-fold cell.
predictions.pred_c_direct_residual_route_is_sufficie: With all suffix writes frozen off, the routed entry program retains signed projection >=0.75 and direction fraction >=0.875 on both targets in both folds.
predictions.pred_d_direct_state_obeys_recurrent_prod: Cell-10 final-state delta matches product(lambdas[0], layers12:18) times the entry12 delta with relative L2 <=1e-5 in every fold.
predictions.pred_e_route_is_control_selective: Joint reset/rescue has zero P/C flips and mean KL <=0.02 in both folds.

decision: A/C/D identifies the literal direct residual-to-final-head route for the selective v15 program; B quantifies downstream write adjustment. Failure of C sends localization to later complete-state nonlinear reconstruction. This does not repair the failed v16 router or license adoption.
